scope: Descendants outside the backend's process group (stdio MCP servers, Docker sandbox containers) and the macOS installed lifecycle (upgrade, rollback, newer-workspace refusal, uninstall data retention). Ad-hoc signed builds; not Linux/Windows; no workspace chooser yet.
implemented: Fixed: serve_studio ran end_owned_process_group in its finally block, so any native startup error (e.g. a newer workspace) SIGKILLed the backend before its message and exit status reached the shell. Group cleanup now runs only after a normal shutdown.

NewerStateError (ValueError subclass, exit 65) for a workspace whose schema is newer than this release; the CLI exits 65 with the message and the shell shows a 'newer workspace' screen. Other invalid versions keep plain ValueError.
Shell grace raised from 5 s to 12 s, above the backend's 10 s bounded close, so a slow healthy close is not cut off; the window hides immediately on close/quit.

mcp_stdio.method: Installed connected backend launched as the shell does; persistent stdio MCP connector created and discovered through the authenticated API; synthetic server (system Python) that starts its own child; 'polite' exits on stdin EOF, 'stubborn' ignores it.

results.hard_kill_no_close: polite cleaned; stubborn server and its child survive

mcp_stdio.note: MCP SDK 2.3 starts stdio servers with start_new_session=True and hides the process; no private-API hook was added.

docker_sandbox.method: Real StudioSandbox with a pinned local python:3.14-slim image ID and 5 s timeout; driving process SIGKILLed mid-job.

results: 1.0.0 installed and real app healthy; agent created
Replaced with 1.0.1: real app healthy on the existing workspace, agent present, schema still 1
Rolled back to 1.0.0: real app healthy, agent present
Newer schema (2): 1.0.0 refused by silent SIGKILL (bug reproduced on the old build), 1.0.1 exits 65 with the message; workspace byte-identical in both
User saw the installed 1.0.1 app show the newer-version message
Uninstall (delete app): workspace and agent files kept
lifecycle.workspace: Real app-data path ~/Library/Application Support/com.nexusarc.studio/workspace; created by the drill and removed afterwards.

remaining: Stubborn (EOF-ignoring) stdio MCP servers after a backend crash; would need SDK support or a verified process ledger.
Workspace chooser/import flow in the native app; pre-import backup restore via the normal recovery flow from the app.
Real schema migrations with pre-upgrade backup (current release has only schema 1).
Developer ID signing/notarization, signature-verified updates, Linux/Windows.
